thread:
oliver: opened PR to tidy up the rate/quotas docs: add a compact SDK header snippet, a CSV example for metering ingestion, and fix an old grafana link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4510. Asking for quick reviews because this touches multiple pages.

sana: Thanks Oliver. Can you paste the CSV header you plan to ship so I can validate against the pipeline? We need billing_event_id + iso utc ts explicitly.

oliver: CSV header I added:

```csv
timestamp_iso,billing_event_id,customer_id,plan,tokens_used,endpoint,response_code
```

sample row: `2026-03-16T09:12:00Z,evt_a1b2c3,user_987,pro,450,/v1/embeddings,200`

note in the docs says timestamps must be normalized to UTC and ISO8601.

tess: Nice. For SDK snippets please add both a python requests example showing `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and a node fetch example. Also a short callout that `Remaining` may be negative briefly if multiple concurrent requests race.

jonah: We also want a short paragraph about burst credits and how the dashboard shows gross vs net tokens. Suggest an inline calc example: `net_tokens = tokens_used - burst_credit_applied` and show net on the primary series and gross as an annotation.

oliver: Added the burst paragraph and a 5-row mock dataset demonstrating a 2-minute spike and the applied burst credit. I also updated `docs/pricing/tiers.md` with a caution that dashboard panels aggregate hourly, not per-minute quotas.

docs-ci-bot: CI: markdown linter failed on `docs/billing/overview.md` (line 78: broken link to /grafana/panels/old-metering).

oliver: I'll replace the grafana reference with the new panel asset path `docs/assets/panels/metering-summary.json` and push.

sana: One more request: add `billing_event_id` to the example in `docs/usage/faq.md` where we explain discrepancy investigations. Our support tooling expects that column.

tess: For the node snippet, small backoff example would be helpful:

```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${KEY}`, 'X-Client-Version':'docs-sample' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' }) })
console.log(res.status, res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining'))
```

and then note: on 429, retry with exponential backoff using the `Retry-After` header if present.

jonah: Panel JSON needs plan enum order to match docs (free, pro, enterprise) else stacked colors look wrong. I flagged that in a comment on the PR.

oliver: Thanks Jonah, fixed ordering and adjusted colors to match the brand palette. Also added a changelog line in the PR: `docs: metering CSV + SDK header snippets + panel asset; clarify burst credits and quota aggregation`.

sana: I'll do a content review tomorrow morning. If CI passes and no other blockers, we can merge by EOD.

docs-ci-bot: CI re-run: linkcheck passed, markdown linter passed, panel JSON schema validated.

tess: LGTM from me after tiny wording nit on the burst paragraph (suggest swapping sentence order).

oliver: Addressed wording nit and squashed commits. Ready to merge once Sana gives final ack.

sana: ack from me, looks good. 

oliver: Merging now, will tag release notes `docs: improve metering examples and dashboard assets` and add a short entry to the docs changelog.

(END)
